page: Google Cloud Platform ct6e-standard-1t is an accelerator-optimized server instance belonging to the ct6e family. It features 44 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture paired with 176 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The primary differentiator of this instance is the integration of a single Google TPU v6e accelerator equipped with 32 GB of dedicated VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring users to provision external network resources separately if public internet routing is required.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ct6e-standard-1t provides a specialized hardware profile that balances a high-capacity host system with a dedicated machine learning accelerator. This resource density is designed for workloads that require moderate host memory and compute alongside TPU-accelerated processing. It is specifically suited for machine learning inference, medium-scale model training, and data preprocessing pipelines that leverage Google TPU hardware.
